questions.question: What is the core idea of Kubernetes management?
options: Declarative: describe the desired state, and Kubernetes keeps matching reality to it
Imperative: run one command per change, in order
Manual: an operator restarts failed containers
Scheduled: changes apply once a night

questions.question: In a rolling update, what stops a broken new version from getting traffic?
questions.explanation: Traffic arrives only when the readiness probe passes. A new pod that never becomes ready stops the rollout, and the old pods keep serving.
